Summary by CodeRabbit

  • 新功能

    • 支持在聊天消息发送和编辑时添加、预览及删除图片附件。

Wait for selected images before submitting the rewrite

If the user selects an image and immediately clicks resend or presses Ctrl/⌘+Enter, the existing text or attachments already keep hasContent true while the new FileReader may still be pending. This call invalidates that reader and submits the current images array, silently omitting the newly selected image; track pending reads and disable or defer submission until they finish.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Code Review

This pull request refactors image attachment handling in the copilot chat by introducing a new custom hook useImageAttachments. This hook centralizes image attachment state, file validation, and reading logic, and is integrated into both the main AgentCopilot input and the inline MessageEditor within MessageRow. Additionally, the changes allow editing user messages that contain only image attachments, and corresponding unit tests have been added.

Feedback on the PR suggests two performance and UX improvements in the new useImageAttachments hook:

  1. Optimizing attachmentToImagePayload by using indexOf and substring instead of split(",") to avoid creating large temporary string arrays.
  2. Improving addFiles to slice the incoming files array based on remaining capacity before reading them into memory, which prevents unnecessary memory overhead and allows displaying a helpful error message when the limit is exceeded.

在 addFiles 中，如果用户一次性选择或拖入了超过限制数量的图片，代码仍然会无条件地为所有图片创建 FileReader 并读取到内存中，最后在 setImages 时才被过滤掉。这在选择大图时会造成不必要的内存和 CPU 开销。此外，超出限制的图片会被静默忽略，用户得不到任何反馈。\n\n建议将 images.length 引入 useCallback 的依赖项，在读取文件前先根据剩余容量进行 slice 裁剪，并在超出限制时设置友好的错误提示。

  const addFiles = useCallback((files: File[]) => {\n    setError(null);\n    const generation = generationRef.current;\n    const imageFiles = files.filter((file) => file.type.startsWith(\"image/\"));\n    const remainingCapacity = MAX_ATTACHED_IMAGES - images.length;\n\n    if (imageFiles.length > remainingCapacity) {\n      setError(t(\"max_images_hint\", { count: MAX_ATTACHED_IMAGES }));\n    }\n\n    const filesToProcess = imageFiles.slice(0, remainingCapacity);\n\n    for (const file of filesToProcess) {\n      if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) {\n        setError(t(\"image_too_large_hint\", { name: file.name }));\n        continue;\n      }\n      const reader = new FileReader();\n      reader.onload = (event) => {\n        if (generationRef.current !== generation) return;\n        const dataUrl = event.target?.result;\n        if (typeof dataUrl !== \"string\") return;\n        setImages((current) => {\n          if (current.length >= MAX_ATTACHED_IMAGES) return current;\n          return [...current, { id: uid(), dataUrl, mimeType: file.type }];\n        });\n      };\n      reader.readAsDataURL(file);\n    }\n  }, [t, images.length]);

export function attachmentToImagePayload(image: AttachedImage): ImagePayload {
return {
data: image.dataUrl.split(",")[1] ?? "",
media_type: image.mimeType,
};
}
export function attachmentToImagePayload(image: AttachedImage): ImagePayload {
const commaIndex = image.dataUrl.indexOf(",");
return {
data: commaIndex !== -1 ? image.dataUrl.substring(commaIndex + 1) : "",
media_type: image.mimeType,
};
}

在组件卸载（unmount）时，虽然 generationRef.current 递增了，但 readQueueRef.current 中可能仍有未处理的文件。当当前正在读取的文件完成时，finishRead 仍会触发 processNext，从而继续读取队列中的下一个文件，这在组件已经卸载的情况下会造成不必要的 CPU 和内存资源浪费。\n\n建议在 useEffect 的清理函数中同时清空 readQueueRef.current，以彻底终止文件读取链。

generationRef.current += 1;
}, []);
useEffect(() => () => {
generationRef.current += 1;
readQueueRef.current = [];
}, []);
